options.query:
index=ad host=DC01 EventCode=4771 Failure_Code="0x18" Client_Address!="::1"
| bin _time span=5m
| stats count as c by _time Account_Name Client_Address host
| where c > 2
| eval Alert="Kerberos Password Brute Force", Severity="Medium", Technique="T1110.003", Tactic="Credential Access"
| append [search index=ad host=DC01 EventCode=4728 Group_Name="Domain Admins"
    | eval Alert="New Domain Admin After Account Creation", Severity="High", Technique="T1098", Tactic="Persistence"]
| append [search index=ad host=DC01 EventCode=4662 ("1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" OR "1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2") Account_Name!="*$"
    | eval Alert="Potential DCSync Attack", Severity="Critical", Technique="T1003.006", Tactic="Credential Access"]
| append [search index=sysmon host=DC01 EventCode=1 Image="*\\cmd.exe" ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe" User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM" CommandLine="*Windows\\Temp*"
    | eval Alert="Remote Command Execution via Task Scheduler", Severity="Medium", Technique="T1053.005", Tactic="Execution"]
| append [search index=sysmon EventCode=1 (Image="*\\powershell.exe" OR Image="*\\pwsh.exe") (CommandLine="* -enc*" OR CommandLine="* -e *" OR CommandLine="*-EncodedCommand*" OR CommandLine="*FromBase64String*" OR CommandLine="*-w hidden*" OR CommandLine="*-nop*")
    | eval Alert="Obfuscated PowerShell Execution", Severity="High", Technique="T1059.001", Tactic="Execution"]
| append [search index=sysmon ((EventCode=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" (GrantedAccess="0x1010" OR GrantedAccess="0x1410" OR GrantedAccess="0x1438" OR GrantedAccess="0x143a" OR GrantedAccess="0x1fffff") NOT (SourceImage="*\\csrss.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\wininit.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\services.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\MsMpEng.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\svchost.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\lsm.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\wmiprvse.exe")) OR (EventCode=1 (CommandLine="*comsvcs*MiniDump*" OR CommandLine="*procdump*lsass*" OR CommandLine="*-ma lsass*")))
    | eval Alert="LSASS Memory Access - Credential Dumping", Severity="Critical", Technique="T1003.001", Tactic="Credential Access"]
| append [search index=sysmon EventCode=1 Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="*/create*"
    | eval Alert="Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation", Severity="Medium", Technique="T1053.005", Tactic="Persistence"]
| append [search index=sysmon EventCode=13 (TargetObject="*\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*" OR TargetObject="*\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*") NOT TargetObject="*\\RunOnce\\GrpConv" NOT (Image="*\\OneDriveSetup.exe" OR Image="*\\OneDrive.exe" OR Image="*\\msedge.exe" OR Image="*\\EdgeWebView\\*" OR Image="*\\Microsoft\\EdgeUpdate\\*" OR Image="*\\Teams.exe" OR Image="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\*\\Installer\\setup.exe" OR Image="*\\VBoxDrvInst.exe" OR Image="*\\DrvInst.exe")
    | eval Alert="Registry Run Key Modification", Severity="Medium", Technique="T1547.001", Tactic="Persistence"]
| append [search index=sysmon EventCode=7 ImageLoaded="*\\msys-2.0.dll" NOT (Image="*\\Program Files\\Git\\*" OR Image="*\\msys64\\*" OR Image="*\\cygwin*")
    | eval Alert="Suspicious RWX DLL Load - MockingJay", Severity="High", Technique="T1055", Tactic="Defense Evasion"]
| stats count as Hits min(_time) as First_Seen max(_time) as Last_Seen values(Severity) as Severity values(Technique) as Technique values(Tactic) as Tactic values(host) as Host by Alert
| eval sev_order=case(Severity="Critical",1,Severity="High",2,Severity="Medium",3,true(),4)
| sort sev_order - Last_Seen
| eval First_Seen=strftime(First_Seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), Last_Seen=strftime(Last_Seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| append [| makeresults
    | eval Severity="Medium", Alert="Kerberos User Enumeration", Technique="T1087.002", Tactic="Discovery", Host="DC01", Hits=0, First_Seen="-", Last_Seen="Visibility gap: Kerberos failure auditing disabled"]
| table Severity Alert Technique Tactic Host Hits First_Seen Last_Seen

index=sysmon host=DC01 EventCode=1 Image="*\\cmd.exe" ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe" User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM" CommandLine="*Windows\\Temp*"
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| table Time host User ParentImage CommandLine
| sort - Time
| tstats dc(sourcetype) as sources where index=ad OR index=sysmon OR index=wineventlog

index=ad host=DC01 ((EventCode=4771 Failure_Code="0x18") OR (EventCode=4625)) Client_Address!="::1"
| eval Source=coalesce(Client_Address, Source_Network_Address)
| eval Source=replace(Source,"^::ffff:","")
| stats count as Failed_Attempts dc(Account_Name) as Accounts_Targeted values(Account_Name) as Accounts min(_time) as First_Seen max(_time) as Last_Seen by Source
| eval First_Seen=strftime(First_Seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), Last_Seen=strftime(Last_Seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| sort - Failed_Attempts

index=sysmon ((EventCode=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" (GrantedAccess="0x1010" OR GrantedAccess="0x1410" OR GrantedAccess="0x1438" OR GrantedAccess="0x143a" OR GrantedAccess="0x1fffff") NOT (SourceImage="*\\csrss.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\wininit.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\services.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\MsMpEng.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\svchost.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\lsm.exe" OR SourceImage="*\\wmiprvse.exe")) OR (EventCode=1 (CommandLine="*comsvcs*MiniDump*" OR CommandLine="*procdump*lsass*" OR CommandLine="*-ma lsass*")))
| eval Process=coalesce(SourceImage, Image)
| eval CommandLine=if(len(CommandLine)>100, substr(CommandLine,1,100)."...", CommandLine)
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| table Time host User Process CommandLine
| sort - Time

index=ad host=DC01 EventCode=4662 ("1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" OR "1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2") Account_Name!="*$"
| stats count as Replication_Requests min(_time) as First_Seen max(_time) as Last_Seen by Account_Name host
| eval First_Seen=strftime(First_Seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), Last_Seen=strftime(Last_Seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| rename Account_Name as Account, host as Target_DC

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches splunk_server=local
| search is_scheduled=1 disabled=0 eai:acl.owner!="nobody"
| stats count

index=sysmon ((EventCode=1 Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="*/create*") OR (EventCode=13 (TargetObject="*\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*" OR TargetObject="*\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*") NOT TargetObject="*\\RunOnce\\GrpConv" NOT (Image="*\\OneDriveSetup.exe" OR Image="*\\OneDrive.exe" OR Image="*\\msedge.exe" OR Image="*\\EdgeWebView\\*" OR Image="*\\Microsoft\\EdgeUpdate\\*" OR Image="*\\Teams.exe" OR Image="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\*\\Installer\\setup.exe" OR Image="*\\VBoxDrvInst.exe" OR Image="*\\DrvInst.exe")))
| eval Technique=if(EventCode=1,"T1053.005 Scheduled Task","T1547.001 Run Key")
| eval Detail=coalesce(TargetObject, CommandLine)
| eval Detail=if(len(Detail)>100, substr(Detail,1,100)."...", Detail)
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| table Time host Technique Image Detail
| sort - Time
| tstats dc(host) as hosts where index=ad OR index=sysmon OR index=wineventlog

index=sysmon EventCode=7 ImageLoaded="*\\msys-2.0.dll" NOT (Image="*\\Program Files\\Git\\*" OR Image="*\\msys64\\*" OR Image="*\\cygwin*")
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| table Time host User Image ImageLoaded Signed
| sort - Time

index=sysmon EventCode=1 (Image="*\\powershell.exe" OR Image="*\\pwsh.exe") (CommandLine="* -enc*" OR CommandLine="* -e *" OR CommandLine="*-EncodedCommand*" OR CommandLine="*FromBase64String*" OR CommandLine="*-w hidden*" OR CommandLine="*-nop*")
| eval CommandLine=if(len(CommandLine)>100, substr(CommandLine,1,100)."...", CommandLine)
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| table Time host User ParentImage CommandLine
| sort - Time

index=ad host=DC01 (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=4756) NOT ("WDAGUtilityAccount" OR "DefaultAccount" OR "krbtgt" OR "Guest" OR "ANONYMOUS LOGON")
| eval Action=case(EventCode=4720,"User account created", EventCode=4728,"Added to global group", EventCode=4732,"Added to local group", EventCode=4756,"Added to universal group")
| eval Performed_By=mvindex(Account_Name,0)
| where NOT like(Performed_By,"%$")
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| table Time Action Group_Name user Performed_By
| rename user as Target_Account
| sort - Time

| stats count as Rules by Tactic
| sort - Rules

| search Hits!=0
| mvexpand Host
| eval Asset_Software=case(Host="DC01","nginx:1.14", true(),"-")
| eval CVE=case(Host="DC01","CVE-2020-15999", true(),"-")
| eval In_KEV=case(Host="DC01","Yes", true(),"No")
| eval Vuln_Severity=case(Host="DC01","Critical", true(),"-")
| eval Final_Severity=if(Vuln_Severity="Critical" AND In_KEV="Yes","Critical",Severity)
| eval Escalated=if(Final_Severity!=Severity,"Yes (Critical + KEV asset)","No")
| eval sev_order=case(Final_Severity="Critical",1,Final_Severity="High",2,Final_Severity="Medium",3,true(),4)
| sort sev_order Alert
| rename Severity as Original_Severity
| table Final_Severity Original_Severity Escalated Alert Host Asset_Software CVE In_KEV
